name: The Bredge
description: Data engineering, analytics, business intelligence and reporting automation for growing businesses.

contact.outcome: A successful response confirms a saved enquiry; do not assume delivery from a button click.
contact.consent: Act only for a person who explicitly authorised the enquiry.

schedule.consent: Book only with explicit approval of the time and attendee details.

automation_policy: Read-only discovery is public. Form submissions use the same anti-abuse checks for humans and agents. Self-identifying as an agent or changing a User-Agent does not bypass security.

agent_authentication.future_option: Web Bot Auth or a separate credentialed service integration, subject to independent access-control review.

evidence_policy: Descriptions and metadata come from published content. Cite canonical Insights/Resources URLs and do not invent client results or guarantees.

interactive_workbenches.limit: 120 requests/minute per Cloudflare location; respect site rate limits and do not automate bulk extraction.
